component.name: IPTVPanel
component.script:
sub init() m.apiBase = "http://1tv41.icu:8080/player_api.php?username=3022207888&password=leonmatthews60@gmail.com" m.streamBase = "http://1tv41.icu:8080/live/3022207888/leonmatthews60@gmail.com"
m.rowH = 40 m.maxRows = 12 m.leftW = 280 m.rightX = 288
m.cBg = "0x0D1117FF" m.cCard = "0x161B22FF" m.cSel = "0x238636FF" m.cText = "0xE6EDF3FF" m.cSub = "0x8B949EFF" m.cBorder = "0x30363DFF" m.cBlue = "0x58A6FFFF" m.cGreen = "0x3FB950FF" m.cRed = "0xF85149FF"
' state m.cats = [] ' [{category_id, category_name}, ...] m.catIdx = 0 m.catOffset = 0
m.streams = [] ' [{name, stream_id, stream_icon}, ...] m.streamOffset= 0 m.streamCursor= 0 m.focusSide = "cat" ' "cat" or "stream" m.loaded = false m.loadingStreams = false
buildChrome()
' two ApiTask instances - one for categories, one for streams m.catTask = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.catTask.observeField("result", "onCategories")
m.streamTask = createObject("roSGNode", "ApiTask") m.streamTask.observeField("result", "onStreams") end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub buildChrome() bg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") bg.translation = [0, 0] bg.width = 1280 bg.height = 624 bg.color = m.cBg
' title bar tb = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") tb.translation = [36, 12] tb.width = 1208 tb.height = 40 tb.color = m.cCard
titleLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") titleLbl.translation = [52, 19] titleLbl.text = "[TV] LIVE TV" titleLbl.font = "font:MediumBoldSystemFont" titleLbl.color = m.cText
m.statusLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.statusLbl.translation = [800, 23] m.statusLbl.text = "Press OK to load categories" m.statusLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.statusLbl.width = 440
' category sidebar sideBar = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") sideBar.translation = [36, 62] sideBar.width = m.leftW sideBar.height = 538 sideBar.color = m.cCard
sideHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") sideHdr.translation = [52, 70] sideHdr.text = "CATEGORIES" sideHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" sideHdr.color = m.cBlue
m.catList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.catList.translation = [36, 94]
' stream area chArea = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") chArea.translation = [m.rightX + 36, 62] chArea.width = 1280 - m.rightX - 72 chArea.height = 538 chArea.color = m.cCard
chHdr = m.top.createChild("Label") chHdr.translation = [m.rightX + 52, 70] chHdr.text = "CHANNELS" chHdr.font = "font:SmallBoldSystemFont" chHdr.color = m.cBlue
m.streamCountLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.streamCountLbl.translation = [880, 70] m.streamCountLbl.text = "" m.streamCountLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.streamCountLbl.color = m.cSub
m.streamList = m.top.createChild("Group") m.streamList.translation = [m.rightX + 36, 94]
' hint bar hintBg = m.top.createChild("Rectangle") hintBg.translation = [36, 586] hintBg.width = 1208 hintBg.height = 30 hintBg.color = "0x0D1117FF"
m.hintLbl = m.top.createChild("Label") m.hintLbl.translation = [52, 591] m.hintLbl.text = "<> Pane ^v Navigate OK = Select * = Reload" m.hintLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" m.hintLbl.color = m.cSub m.hintLbl.width = 1160 end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function load(args as Dynamic) if m.loaded then return invalid m.statusLbl.text = "Loading categories..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.catTask.url = "" m.catTask.url = m.apiBase + "&action=get_live_categories" end function
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub onCategories() raw = m.catTask.result if raw = invalid m.statusLbl.text = "X No response from server" m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if ' unwrap array if ApiTask wrapped it if raw.doesExist("_isArray") data = raw._arr else if raw.doesExist("error") m.statusLbl.text = "X " + raw.error m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return else m.statusLbl.text = "X Not an array" m.statusLbl.color = m.cRed return end if
m.cats = data m.catIdx = 0 m.catOffset = 0 m.loaded = true m.statusLbl.text = str(data.count()).trim() + " categories loaded" m.statusLbl.color = m.cGreen renderCats() loadStreams() end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub loadStreams() if m.cats.count() = 0 then return cat = m.cats[m.catIdx] catId = "" if cat.doesExist("category_id") then catId = cat.category_id m.loadingStreams = true m.streams = [] m.streamOffset = 0 m.streamCursor = 0 renderStreams()
m.catNameForStreams = "" if cat.doesExist("category_name") then m.catNameForStreams = cat.category_name
m.streamTask.url = "" m.streamTask.url = m.apiBase + "&action=get_live_streams&category_id=" + catId end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub onStreams() raw = m.streamTask.result m.loadingStreams = false if raw = invalid or not raw.doesExist("_isArray") m.streamCountLbl.text = "error loading" renderStreams() return end if data = raw._arr m.streams = data m.streamOffset = 0 m.streamCursor = 0 m.streamCountLbl.text = str(data.count()).trim() + " ch" renderStreams() end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub renderCats() while m.catList.getChildCount() > 0 m.catList.removeChildIndex(0) end while
maxShow = 12 y = 0 startI = m.catOffset endI = startI + maxShow - 1 if endI >= m.cats.count() then endI = m.cats.count() - 1
for i = startI to endI cat = m.cats[i] localI = i - startI
isSel = (i = m.catIdx) and (m.focusSide = "cat") isActive = (i = m.catIdx)
rowBg = m.catList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = m.leftW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel then rowBg.color = m.cSel else if isActive then rowBg.color = "0x21262DFF" else rowBg.color = m.cBg
name = "" if cat.doesExist("category_name") then name = cat.category_name
lbl = m.catList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [14, y + 10] lbl.text = name lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isActive then lbl.color = m.cText else lbl.color = m.cSub lbl.width = m.leftW - 20 lbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..."
y = y + m.rowH end for
if m.cats.count() = 0 hint = m.catList.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [14, 16] hint.text = "Loading..." hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = m.cSub end if end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- sub renderStreams() while m.streamList.getChildCount() > 0 m.streamList.removeChildIndex(0) end while
if m.loadingStreams lbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [14, 16] lbl.text = "Loading channels..." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub return end if
if m.streams.count() = 0 lbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") lbl.translation = [14, 16] lbl.text = "No channels in this category." lbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" lbl.color = m.cSub return end if
chW = 1280 - m.rightX - 80 y = 0 endIdx = m.streamOffset + m.maxRows - 1 if endIdx >= m.streams.count() then endIdx = m.streams.count() - 1
for i = m.streamOffset to endIdx s = m.streams[i] localI = i - m.streamOffset isSel = (localI = m.streamCursor) and (m.focusSide = "stream")
rowBg = m.streamList.createChild("Rectangle") rowBg.translation = [0, y] rowBg.width = chW rowBg.height = m.rowH - 2 if isSel then rowBg.color = m.cSel else if i mod 2 = 0 then rowBg.color = m.cBg else rowBg.color = "0x161B22FF"
' number numLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") numLbl.translation = [10, y + 10] numLbl.text = str(i + 1).trim() numLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" numLbl.color = m.cSub numLbl.width = 52
' name name = "" if s.doesExist("name") then name = s.name nameLbl = m.streamList.createChild("Label") nameLbl.translation = [66, y + 10] nameLbl.text = name nameLbl.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" if isSel then nameLbl.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else nameLbl.color = m.cText nameLbl.width = chW - 70 nameLbl.truncateOnDelimiter = "..."
y = y + m.rowH end for
if m.streams.count() > m.maxRows hint = m.streamList.createChild("Label") hint.translation = [10, y + 6] hint.text = "^v scroll - " + str(m.streams.count()).trim() + " total" hint.font = "font:SmallSystemFont" hint.color = m.cSub end if end sub
' --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean if not press then return false
if m.focusSide = "cat" if key = "up" if m.catIdx > 0 m.catIdx = m.catIdx - 1 if m.catIdx < m.catOffset then m.catOffset = m.catIdx renderCats() loadStreams() end if return true else if key = "down" if m.catIdx < m.cats.count() - 1 m.catIdx = m.catIdx + 1 if m.catIdx >= m.catOffset + m.maxRows then m.catOffset = m.catIdx - m.maxRows + 1 renderCats() loadStreams() end if return true else if key = "right" or key = "OK" if m.streams.count() > 0 m.focusSide = "stream" renderCats() renderStreams() end if return true else if key = "replay" m.loaded = false m.statusLbl.text = "Reloading..." m.statusLbl.color = m.cSub m.catTask.url = "" m.catTask.url = m.apiBase + "&action=get_live_categories" return true end if
else ' focusSide = "stream" if key = "left" m.focusSide = "cat" renderCats() renderStreams() return true else if key = "up" if m.streamCursor > 0 m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor - 1 else if m.streamOffset > 0 m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset - 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "down" if m.streamCursor < m.maxRows - 1 and (m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor) < m.streams.count() - 1 m.streamCursor = m.streamCursor + 1 else if m.streamOffset + m.maxRows < m.streams.count() m.streamOffset = m.streamOffset + 1 end if renderStreams() return true else if key = "OK" idx = m.streamOffset + m.streamCursor if idx >= 0 and idx < m.streams.count() s = m.streams[idx] streamId = "" if s.doesExist("stream_id") then streamId = str(s.stream_id).trim() name = "" if s.doesExist("name") then name = s.name if streamId <> "" url = m.streamBase + "/" + streamId + ".m3u8" ch = {name: name, url: url, group: m.catNameForStreams, logo: "", tvgId: streamId} m.hintLbl.text = "> NOW PLAYING: " + name m.hintLbl.color = m.cGreen m.top.selectedChannel = ch end if end if return true else if key = "replay" loadStreams() return true end if end if
return false end function
